content.short: Beyond Rockets City is an entire ecosystem of NFTs based on the Cardano Blockchain.
content.description:
Beyond Rockets City is an entire ecosystem of NFTs based on the Cardano Blockchain. Here you can own rooms in the Cardano Tower, own the Shelley Supermarket, houses in the Adaville and many other locations in the city. You can buy items, vehicles, avatars and so much more. The city welcomes you, you belong here.

In the crazy world of crypto, we often hear ourselves say “to the moon!!!” to celebrate the rising value of assets we’ve invested in. And while nothing is wrong with this, it can be very easy to lose sight of the important things‒faith, family, friendships, and health‒once we immerse ourselves into money and crypto.

What even is going to the moon for if we forget the things that matter the most?

Beyond Rockets is more than just going to the moon, it is more importantly about being grounded, being anchored. That’s the story behind the city’s name. May you see and enjoy life a little bit more through these art.
